% Cylindrical divergence (general vector)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_div}
\nabla\cdot\mathbf{v} = \frac{1}{R}\partial_R(R v_R) + \frac{1}{R}\partial_\phi v_\phi + \partial_z v_z
\end{equation}

% Cylindrical curl (B field)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_curl}
(\nabla\times\mathbf{B})_R = \tfrac{1}{R}\partial_\phi B_z - \partial_z B_\phi,\ (\nabla\times\mathbf{B})_\phi = \partial_z B_R - \partial_R B_z,\ (\nabla\times\mathbf{B})_z = \tfrac{1}{R}\!\left[\partial_R(R B_\phi) - \partial_\phi B_R\right]
\end{equation}

% Axisymmetric radial-flux conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_flux}
\partial_\phi = \partial_z = 0,\ \mathbf{B} = B_R\hat{R}\ \Rightarrow\ R\,B_R(R) = \text{const}
\end{equation}

% Radial momentum in cylindrical (axisymmetric)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_mom_R}
\partial_t(\rho v_R) + \frac{1}{R}\partial_R(R \rho v_R^{2}) + \partial_z(\rho v_R v_z) = \frac{\rho v_\phi^{2}}{R} - \partial_R p - \rho \partial_R\Phi_{\mathrm{grav}}
\end{equation}

% Centrifugal source term (MRI background driver)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_centrifugal}
\text{The }+\rho v_\phi^{2}/R\text{ term is the Christoffel-symbol source: it is what keeps a disk in rotational equilibrium against gravity.}
\end{equation}

% Induction equation (axisymmetric, ∂_φ = 0)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_ind_BR}
\partial_t B_R = -\partial_z(v_z B_R - v_R B_z)
\end{equation}

% Induction equation, toroidal B_φ
\begin{equation}\label{eq:D1_ind_Bphi}
\partial_t B_\phi = \partial_z(v_\phi B_z - v_z B_\phi) - \partial_R(v_R B_\phi - v_\phi B_R)
